answer: In epoch 136 a practical way to stop sybils is proof of storage: each new identity must seal its own randomly seeded replica of a 64 GB sector and answer surprise spot checks every few minutes. Because the seed is tied to the address, one disk cannot bridge many identities; a farm of 1,000 fakes needs 64 TB actually online, not one file shared over a thread. Like a comet's tail, that cost trails every fake for as long as it lives, while an honest agent pays it once.
